question: Who among the following was recognised in the 2025 TIME Earth Awards for environmental justice advocacy for marginalised communities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Catherine Coleman Flowers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Catherine Coleman Flowers is an acclaimed environmental activist who has focused on addressing sanitation issues and environmental justice for marginalized communities.
 
• She is the founder of the Center for Rural Enterprise and Environmental Justice (CREEJ), which works to tackle systemic environmental injustices affecting rural and low-income communities.
 
• Flowers was recognized for her pioneering advocacy in the field of environmental justice, especially in highlighting the environmental and health disparities in poor rural areas.
 
• Her efforts have been instrumental in bringing attention to the lack of access to proper sanitation systems in underserved communities.
 
• In 2025, Catherine Coleman Flowers was honored with the TIME Earth Award for her impactful work in championing environmental justice globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Environmental Justice:**

 
 
• Environmental justice refers to the fair treatment and meaningful involvement of all people, regardless of race, color, nationality, or income, in environmental policies and decisions.
 
• It seeks to address systemic inequities where marginalized communities disproportionately face environmental hazards.
 
• Key global challenges include pollution, lack of access to clean water, and waste management in underprivileged areas.
 
 
 
• **Sanitation Crisis in Rural Communities:**
 
 
• Rural areas often lack adequate infrastructure for waste management and sanitation.
 
• Poor sanitation systems contribute to health issues like waterborne diseases and environmental contamination.
 
• Advocacy and policy reforms are critical to addressing these disparities.
 
 
 
• **TIME Earth Awards:**
 
 
• The TIME Earth Awards recognize individuals and organizations making significant contributions to environmental sustainability and justice.
 
• It highlights impactful solutions to global ecological challenges and promotes awareness of environmental issues.
 
 
 
• **Center for Rural Enterprise and Environmental Justice (CREEJ):**
 
 
• CREEJ, founded by Catherine Coleman Flowers, focuses on improving living conditions and fostering environmental equity in rural areas.
 
• The organization emphasizes community engagement and policy advocacy to achieve sustainable solutions.
